# GitHub Copilot instructions

All conventions for this repository live in **[CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)** —
content layers, the header block, tags, voice, the Mermaid palette and fence
format, the required checks, and the rule that no file under `docs/` may move
without a redirect.

Read that file. This one is intentionally a pointer: two instruction files drift
apart, and the previous version of this file had drifted badly enough to
contradict CLAUDE.md on the diagram palette and to require a nav section that no
longer exists.

Before changing anything under `docs/` or `mkdocs.yml`, also read
`planning/STATUS.md` and `planning/README.md`.
